verdict.rationale: Better Stack's own status page product supports email subscriptions to the whole page or to selected components, and private status pages for internal teams protected by SSO, password, or IP. That gives stakeholders a subscribable update channel outside the incident Slack channel. However, the subscription docs are framed for customers, and nothing explicitly confirms that subscriptions work on private internal pages or describes structured incident update formats. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that internal private-page subscribers receive updates, detail on structured incident update content and templates, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an engineering leader, internal stakeholders get structured incident updates they can subscribe to, without joining the war room

citations.quote: Let your customers subscribe to e-mail updates removing the need to reach out to you individually.
Let your customers subscribe to the entire status page or just selected components.
Create a private status page for internal teams or enterprise customers.
To create a private status page, use the password protection to only allow chosen people to access it.
